title: ALMA Observations of the Inner Cavity in the Protoplanetary Disk around Sz 84
question: What is the radial structure of the inner cavity in the dust disk of Sz 84 for large (mm) versus small (sub-micron) grains, and what does it imply for grain growth and fragmentation?

recipe.goal: Calibrate, self-calibrate and image the Band 6 continuum and 12CO
recipe.method: Calibrate with ALMA scripts in CASA, one round of phase self-cal, correct phase centers with fixvis using Gaia proper motions, CLEAN with multi-frequency deconvolution and uv-taper; subtract continuum with uvcontsub and image 12CO cube at 1.0 km/s

recipe.goal: Fit the Band 6 (and Band 3, 7) visibilities with a parametric brightness profile
recipe.method: Power-law radial profile with two cavity radii and a depth delta; model image converted to visibilities with vis_sample, deprojected, azimuthally averaged in 20 klambda bins (real part) and fit with emcee
key_parameters: 8 free parameters (F_total, r_cav1, r_cav2, delta, gamma1, gamma2, i, PA); phase center fixed
2000 burn-in steps plus 2000 steps, 4000 total, 200 walkers
Outer radius of model 300 au; delta left free after delta=0 failed
assumptions: No emission inside r_cav1 because the SED shows negligible NIR excess

recipe.method: Spectral index from total flux densities at bands 3, 6 (this work, visibility fits) and 7 (literature)

recipe.goal: Measure 12CO moment maps and dynamical mass
recipe.method: Moment 0 and moment 1 maps, PV diagram along PA 165.71 deg with i = 75.13 deg, overplotting Keplerian peak-emission loci for stellar masses 0.2 to 0.6 Msun
key_parameters: PA 165.71 deg and i 75.13 deg taken from the visibility fit
assumptions: Foreground cloud absorption negligible in the central CO region because of high inclination

recipe.goal: Constrain small- and large-grain cavity sizes with MCRT SED modeling
recipe.method: HOCHUNK3D Monte Carlo radiative transfer with a two-layer disk; four-step manual fitting: initial h_small and M_disk at r_cav1=10 au, r_cav2_small=55 au; iterate q1, q2 to match band 6 surface brightness; vary r_cav2_small 40-80 au; vary r_cav1_large 1, 8, 26 au
key_parameters: Free parameters r_cav1_large, r_cav2_small, h_small(100 au), M_disk
r_cav2_large fixed to 26 au from the visibility fit
Scale height of large grains fixed at 1 au at 100 au; small grains varied to match 60-70 um flux
Large-grain mass fraction 0.9; accretion rate 1.3e-9 Msun/yr; inclination 75 deg
assumptions: Scale height exponent p = 1.25 with T proportional to r^-0.5; size distribution n(s) ~ s^-3.5

recipe.goal: Check consistency of visibility-fit and MCRT surface brightness
recipe.method: Compare the two band 6 surface-brightness profiles convolved with a 0.2 arcsec beam

recipe.goal: Upper limit on small-grain mass inside the cavity
recipe.method: Optically thin emission from small grains with surface density power law, temperature from HOCHUNK3D, scaled to the 10 um IR excess upper limit; sensitivity tested over wavelength, r_min, r_max, alpha
assumptions: Surface density power law with exponent alpha; inclination not needed
